name: bizplug-retail
description: The retail & e-commerce plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: product search and reserve in store. It works from the business's own published profile, covering products, stock, hours and returns, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Product search and reserve in store for retail & e-commerce businesses.
interface.longDescription: The retail & e-commerce plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: product search and reserve in store. It works from the business's own published profile, covering products, stock, hours and returns, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
defaultPrompt: Product search and reserve in store
Do you have this in stock, and what are your hours?
How do I contact the business?

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.

test_cases.prompt: Product search and reserve in store
test_cases.expect: Calls search_products and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Do you have this in stock, and what are your hours?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls reserve_item only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
